about.title: About Tarsier Labs
about.subtitle: We are building the next-generation user experience platform
about.visionDescription:
Tarsier Labs is a modern web application platform, we are committed to creating the best user experience. We believe good software should be simple, elegant, and efficient.

This blog is where we share technical experience, product thinking, and team daily life. We hope our work can be helpful to you.
about.techStackDescription: Our technology stack is built on modern, scalable, and reliable technologies that power our applications across web, mobile, and backend services.
about.architectureDescription: We adopt a hybrid architecture: Flutter mobile + React Web sandbox + Shorebird hot updates, combined with real-time communication and AI services, creating a full-stack solution.
about.techVue: Progressive JavaScript framework for building user interfaces
about.techFlutter: Cross-platform mobile app framework for iOS and Android
about.techShorebird: Flutter hot update solution supporting incremental updates and fast deployment
about.techCapacitor: Hybrid app development framework using web technologies
about.techSembast: Flutter embedded NoSQL database supporting offline data storage
about.techSqlite: Lightweight embedded database for mobile applications
about.techBullmq: Redis-based message queue system supporting task scheduling
about.techAwsRekognition: Face recognition and liveness detection service
about.techVertexAi: Machine learning model service supporting AI features
about.techAiAgent: AI agent system supporting automated task processing
about.techGithubActions: CI/CD automation pipeline supporting continuous integration and deployment
about.techCloudflare: Edge computing platform providing global CDN and Serverless services
about.techVite: Frontend build tool supporting fast development and hot reload
about.techSentry: Full-stack performance monitoring and error tracking system
about.techJestVitest: Unit testing framework supporting JavaScript and TypeScript
about.techWebsocket: Real-time bidirectional communication protocol for instant messaging
about.techSocketIo: WebSocket library providing real-time communication functionality
about.techFcm: Firebase Cloud Messaging supporting cross-platform notifications
about.techFigmaToken: Design system tokens ensuring UI consistency
about.techSeo: Search engine optimization techniques improving website visibility
about.techNextIntl: Multi-language support library supporting internationalized routing
about.techCategoryFrontendDesc: Core technologies for building user interfaces
about.techCategoryAiDesc: Artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities
about.techCategoryDesignDesc: User experience and search engine optimization
about.coreValueInnovationDesc: Continuously explore new technologies, pursue excellent user experience
about.coreValueSecurityDesc: Focus on data security and system stability, providing reliable services for users
about.coreValuePerformanceDesc: Optimize every line of code, ensure fast system response
about.coreValueUserExperienceDesc: User-centered, create simple and elegant product interfaces
about.teamDescription: We are a passionate technical team dedicated to creating the best product experience
about.contactDescription: Welcome to contact us, share your ideas and suggestions
about.founderDescription: Creator and core developer of Tarsier Labs
